description: Header file defining template classes for vertex data conversion, including identity, cast, normalization, fixed-to-float conversions, and vertex data array conversion logic within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: Template for identity transformation of a type.

classes.name: Cast
classes.description: Template for casting between different types.

classes.name: Normalize
classes.description: Template for normalizing numeric types to float.

classes.name: FixedToFloat
classes.description: Template for converting fixed-point types to float.

classes.name: NoWiden
classes.description: Template for no widening of vertex components.

classes.name: WidenToEven
classes.description: Template for widening vertex components to an even number.

classes.name: WidenToFour
classes.description: Template for widening vertex components to four.

classes.name: SimpleDefaultValues
classes.description: Provides default zero and one values for types.

classes.name: NormalizedDefaultValues
classes.description: Provides default zero and one values for normalized types.

classes.name: VertexDataConverter
classes.description: Template class for converting arrays of vertex data with various rules and conversions.

methods.name: convertArray
methods.description: Converts an array of input vertex data to output format, handling stride and component conversion.

methods.name: copyComponent
methods.description: Copies and converts a single component from input to output, applying default values if necessary.
